name: muse-nlm
description: Fetch NotebookLM links and print readable content as plain text.

commands.list: nlm list — list the signed-in account's notebooks (most recently viewed first)
commands.notebook: nlm notebook <id> — show a notebook's title and its sources
commands.source: nlm source <notebook_id> <source_id> — print one source's full text

status: v0.2.0 — public-page reading live; signed-in notebook reading (list / notebook / source / open on notebook URLs) via batchexecute RPC replay, activates with the one-time session setup
